title: Satoshium Chronicle Base Schema
description: Canonical machine-readable Base Schema for Satoshium Chronicle Entries. Defines universal Chronicle Entry structure and conditional extension points. Event-Type-specific requirements belong in Event-Type Profiles.

entry_id.description: Permanent canonical Chronicle Entry identifier. The identifier remains stable across Corrections and Entry Versions.

schema_id.description: Stable identifier for the Chronicle Base Schema.

schema_version.description: Version of the Chronicle Base Schema governing this Entry.

entry_version.description: Sequential preserved Version of the same canonical Chronicle Entry. Entry Version is distinct from Schema Version.

title.description: Concise human-readable title describing the preserved Occurrence.

summary.description: Brief factual summary of the preserved Occurrence.

event_type.description: Controlled classification of the Occurrence represented by the Entry. Values are governed by the Chronicle Controlled Values Registry.

event_date.description: Date or timestamp of the historical Occurrence itself. Use null only when the Event Date is not determinable under current Chronicle rules.

historical_context.description: Historical context needed to understand the Occurrence. Must remain distinguishable from authoritative source material and Evidence.

verification_state.description: Current Chronicle Verification State for this Entry Version. Verification reviews Chronicle's own historical representation.

lifecycle_state.description: Current Lifecycle State of the Chronicle Entry.

publication_state.description: Current Publication State of the Chronicle Entry.

entry_created_at.description: Timestamp when Chronicle created the Entry.

event_type_profile.description: Reference to the Event-Type Profile governing the Entry when an approved Profile applies.

authoritative_record_references.description: Durable references to authoritative external or Suite-owned records. Reference does not transfer authority.

source_references.description: References to Source Records or referenced external Sources used by the Entry.

evidence_references.description: References to Evidence Records or Evidence items bearing on the Entry or claim.

relationships.description: Structured Relationships connecting the Entry to other Chronicle Entries, authoritative records, or supporting records.

correction_references.description: References to formal Chronicle Correction Records affecting the Entry.

published_at.description: Timestamp when this Entry Version was published.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the most recent non-historical maintenance action affecting the current representation. Does not replace Correction or Version lineage.

limitations.description: Material limitations affecting Chronicle's current historical representation.

origin.description: Origin of the information represented in Chronicle.

acquisition_method.description: Method by which Chronicle accessed, obtained, or captured the information.

retrieved_at.description: Date and time Chronicle retrieved, accessed, or captured the information.

integrity_metadata.description: Optional integrity metadata such as checksums, repository commits, timestamps, signatures, or Anchor references.

version_reference.description: Reference to a preserved prior Version of the same Chronicle Entry.
